options.description: Every run ends by opening the issues as debug cases, running the debug workflow on them and running the task once more; --rounds 0 keeps the old 'document only' form. Costs the self-debug rounds (Sonnet, then Opus) on every run that files an issue. You are asked only when a fix would change intent or meaning, or the merge check holds.
options.label: By itself, every run (Recommended)

options.description: A run documents the issues; you or an agent start the fix rounds with --loop N. Cheapest per run; nothing happens to the issues until someone asks.
options.label: Only with --loop, as built

options.description: Every run opens the issues as debug cases so plumb debug lists them; the fix rounds and the rerun still need --loop. The middle ground: nothing is spent unasked, nothing is forgotten.
options.label: Open the cases, but do not fix

payload.question: Should plumb evaluate fix and rerun by itself after every run, or only when asked with --loop?
